text: CE students following the 2024-2025 catalog must complete 1 math technical elective. The Computer Engineering math technical elective options, with their pre-requisite courses, are: ENGR 3300 Advanced Engineering Mathematics ((MATH 2415 or MATH 2419 or equivalent) and ENGR 2300, with MATH 2420 as a corequisite); MATH 3323 Elementary Number Theory (C- or higher in MATH 2414 or MATH 2418 or MATH 2419); MATH 3397 Mathematical Problem Solving (MATH 2413 or MATH 2417); and STAT 3355 Introduction to Data Analysis (MATH 2414 or MATH 2419 or equivalent).
